description: From the gorge viewpoint at night, Ronda's Puente Nuevo spans the deep chasm in dramatic silhouette. The bridge's great arch is floodlit, its stonework glowing against the black gorge while the river runs far below in darkness. The two halves of the town hang on either cliff edge, lights twinkling along the rims.
